text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's finally here… This is the day!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It was a long, long… no, it wasn't. It was 
a short, short journey. Because it was 
short distance races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But now is the time! The finish line!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Today, in this Takamatsunomiya Kinen, I'll 
face Ms. Flower again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll want to win by a landslide, which 
means we should be aiming for a lead of a 
thousand lengths!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With that kind of overwhelming victory――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It'll be time to start Bakushin-ing to the 
Tenno Sho and Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, from now on, I'll be able to compete 
in races other than short distance ones!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
One more time!! You can say it, can't 
you!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I heard it from you, right here! Well, 
then, I'll be going!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ms. Bakushin O. To be with you again 
is really―

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will risk my career as class 
president to best you by 1000 lengths!
